The bundled verifier reconstructs graph distances for 530604 subsets on 36 boards and checks 11325 further parameter pairs; it completes VERIFY_OK. The universal result relies on the proof, not finite enumeration.

value.rationale: The originating literature exhibits isolated complete-bipartite nonunimodality cases, and later literature adds \(K_{8,8}\). A complete isomorphism-type classification of all failing complete bipartite graphs directly answers the natural missing question, with a structural log-concavity lemma showing that every exception arises at the same degree-three valley. This is a motivated infinite-family shape classification, not a renamed known formula or an arbitrary finite parameter slice.
